abilities.name: LET'S GET STUCK IN
abilities.effect: Set up this unit wholly within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge, and not in combat.

abilities.name: IT'S A HARD LIFE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Gnoblars unit within your general’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+: Heal (X) your general where X is an amount equal to the roll. 1 model in that Gnoblars unit is slain.

abilities.name: FRENZIED ARTILLERY
abilities.effect: If the unmodified charge roll for a friendly Gnoblar Scraplauncher is 6+, add 3 the Attacks characteristic of the target’s Companion weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SAVAGE INSTINCTS
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for your general
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within your general’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by your general has been resolved.

abilities.name: MASSIVE BULK
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Health characteristic of your general.

abilities.name: NASTY TRAP
abilities.timing: Reaction: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of your general to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target your general’s Trap token. While the target has a Trap token, each time the target is picked to use a MOVE or CHARGE ability, roll a dice. On a 4+, that MOVE or CHARGE ability has no effect and the target’s Trap token is removed

abilities.name: VETERAN HUNTER
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of your general to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s combat attacks that target that unit.

abilities.name: STAYING USEFUL
abilities.effect: While any of this unit’s Gnoblar or Frost Sabre tokens are on the battlefield, this unit has WARD (5+). Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, remove 1 of this unit’s tokens from the battlefield. If this unit’s Frost Sabre token has been removed, it can no longer attack with its Frost Sabre’s Fangs.

abilities.name: NO SLACKING!
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice On a 3+, add the result to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn. KEYWORDS HERO, INFANTRY

abilities.name: DOWN TO THE IRONGUTS
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to this unit’s control score. KEYWORDS INFANTRY

abilities.name: NO SHORTAGE OF VOLUNTEERS
abilities.effect: You can return D3 models to this unit. KEYWORDS INFANTRY, REINFORCEMENTS ezstandalone.cmd.push(function() {ezstandalone.showAds(128)});

abilities.name: RAIN OF SCRAP
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any models slain this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn. KEYWORDS WAR MACHINE
